XMLDB.COMMENT:
Sentientia LMS — Microsoft 365 Knowledge Automation (Workstream C), Phase C.1 (scaffold). One table: local_sentientia_m365_tokens — one row per (userid, customerid) holding the encrypted OAuth tokens + their lifecycle metadata.
Encryption: access_token_enc and refresh_token_enc columns store the output of \core\encryption::encrypt() — the Sodium ciphertext is prefixed with the cipher method tag and base64-encoded, so the column is plain ASCII even though it holds ciphertext. Decrypt path goes through \local_sentientia_m365\msal_client::decrypt_token() which wraps the core decrypt and translates any sodium failure into a generic moodle_exception (never leaks why).
Tokens are scoped (userid, customerid) — a single Moodle user under a multi-customer Sentientia deployment may have two distinct Microsoft tenants linked (one per customer) without colliding rows.

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_m365_tokens
TABLE.COMMENT:
Phase C.1 (2026-05-24) — One row per (userid, customerid). Holds the encrypted access + refresh tokens returned by the Microsoft identity platform after a successful OAuth2 Authorization Code grant.
Columns access_token_enc + refresh_token_enc are Sodium-encrypted ciphertext (base64, with method prefix as per \core\encryption::encrypt()). NEVER log the decrypted plaintext. NEVER expose either column through a webservice without going through msal_client::decrypt_token().
expires is the absolute Unix timestamp at which the access token expires. Refresh is required at or before this value.
scopes is a space-separated list of OAuth scopes the user consented to (e.g. 'openid profile offline_access User.Read Sites.Read.All'). Used to decide whether a given Graph call is permitted by the user's current grant — if not, the UI must re-prompt for consent rather than failing silently.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to user.id — the Moodle user who granted consent.

FIELD.NAME: customerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS customer scope (1 = Airpay customer-zero). Allows a single Moodle user under a multi-customer deployment to hold two distinct Microsoft tenant links.

FIELD.NAME: access_token_enc
FIELD.COMMENT: Sodium-encrypted OAuth access token (via \core\encryption::encrypt()). Plaintext is short-lived; encrypt-at-rest still required because logs sometimes capture DB rows.

FIELD.NAME: refresh_token_enc
FIELD.COMMENT: Sodium-encrypted OAuth refresh token. Long-lived (up to 90 days). Compromise = ability to mint new access tokens against the user's Microsoft identity until revoked — MUST encrypt at rest.

FIELD.NAME: expires
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp when access_token expires. msal_client::needs_refresh() returns true within 60 s of this value.

FIELD.NAME: scopes
FIELD.COMMENT: Space-separated list of OAuth scopes granted (e.g. 'openid profile offline_access User.Read Sites.Read.All'). Read by graph_client::ensure_scope() before each call.

INDEX.NAME: uniq_user_customer
INDEX.COMMENT: At most one token row per (user, customer) pair. New auth replaces old via upsert.

INDEX.NAME: idx_expires
INDEX.COMMENT: Periodic refresh job scans for rows where expires is in the past or near future.
